'''GB-3P0''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was owned by the family [[House Bolleon]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Bolleon]] was a collector of artifacts and primitive art and at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, GB-3P0 accompanied Bolleon on an expedition to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durace]], to translate the ancient pictographs that were etched in the walls of the planet's [[Pictograph Caverns|caverns]]. However, something on the world did not want the meaning of the pictographs to be uncovered and it [[Death/Legends|killed]] Bolleon, forcing to GB-3P0 to become a fugitive.
